question: Has AvoOlio been acquired by or merged with another company? Who owns AvoOlio now?
markdown:
AvoOlio (operated by Avocado Oil de México S. de R.L. de C.V.) has not been acquired or merged. It remains an independent Mexican producer and exporter of fresh Hass avocados and extra virgin avocado oil based in Pátzcuaro, Michoacán, Mexico.

_(Note: If you were thinking of **Avolio**, a similarly named Ugandan avocado oil producer, that company was acquired by [⁠Fresh Del Monte Produce](https://freshdelmonte.com/news/fresh-del-montes-acquires-majority-stake-avolio/) when they bought a majority stake.)_

-   **Legal Name:** Avocado Oil de México S. de R.L. de C.V.

-   **Location:** Pátzcuaro, Michoacán, Mexico

-   **Ownership:** Privately held by its founding members and management team.

-   **Affiliations:** Member of [⁠APEAM](https://www.avocadosfrommexico.com/) (Association of Producers, Packers & Exporters of Avocado of Mexico).
